subject: ela
cluster: Range of reading and level of text complexity
intro: When we read fact books together, we listen, look at the pictures, and think about what we learn. We read to find out real information. Kindergartners take part and tell one thing they learned.

items.prompt:
Read.

Penguins are birds that cannot fly. They swim very well and live where it is cold.

Name one thing you learned.

steps: One fact: penguins swim very well.
So one thing I learned is that penguins swim very well.

items.prompt: A fact book is called 'All About Volcanoes.' What will you learn about?

steps: The title tells me the topic: volcanoes.
So I will learn about volcanoes.

items.prompt:
Read.

Honey bees visit flowers. They carry pollen. This helps new flowers grow.

What do bees carry?
A fact book 'How Seeds Grow' will teach about ____.

Read.

Camels store fat in their humps.

Where do camels store fat?
When we read a fact book together, we read to ____.
